biography.characterFamilySituation: Divorced, two kids he sends money to
biography.characterSkin: Olive, grease-stained hands, datajack port visible behind right ear
biography.description: A broad-shouldered ork with quick, sure hands and an easy grin. Diego moves with the relaxed confidence of someone who is always in control -- whether behind the wheel of a van doing 180 kph or elbow-deep in a drone's guts. A visible datajack sits behind his right ear, and the telltale scarring of a control rig implant traces faint lines along the base of his skull. He usually smells faintly of motor oil and ozone.
biography.background: Former Ares Macrotechnology test driver who spent five years pushing prototype vehicles to their limits on closed courses and combat testing grounds. When corporate politics and a rigged internal investigation tried to pin a fatal crash on him, Diego walked away from the corporate life and into the shadows. Now he uses his intimate knowledge of vehicles, drones, and Ares security protocols to make a living as a wheelman and rigger-for-hire. He sends what he can back to his ex-wife and kids in Dallas, and dreams of one day owning a legitimate custom garage. Until then, the shadows pay better than any honest job an ork can find.

system.description: The most popular heavy pistol in the world, especially among mercenaries and shadowrunners. Standard sidearm for Axle.
A popular taser used for non-lethal takedowns. Fires capacitor darts that deliver a powerful electrical shock on contact.
system.gameEffect: Stun damage, -5 AP. Uses capacitor darts instead of standard ammo.

system.description: A collapsible staff made of reinforced composite materials. Extends to full length with a flick of the wrist. Easy to conceal when collapsed.
A concealed ballistic vest worn under clothing. Good protection without drawing attention.
Heavy-duty work coveralls with concealed ballistic weave. Perfect for a rigger who spends as much time in the shop as in the field.
The core implant of any rigger, the control rig provides a direct neural interface with vehicles and drones. Allows the user to 'jump in' and control them as an extension of their own body.
system.gameEffect: Rating 2: +2 dice to all Vehicle Tests when jumped in. Provides VR bonuses when rigging. Reduces thresholds for vehicle tests by 2 when jumped in.

system.description: A datajack provides a direct neural interface with retractable micro-cable for plugging into devices.
Implanted adrenal gland boosters and neural accelerators that improve reaction time. Essential for high-speed driving.
system.gameEffect: Adds its rating to Reaction attribute. Cannot be combined with Wired Reflexes.

system.description: A rugged step van popular with security firms and shadowrunner teams. Axle's primary work vehicle, heavily modified with improved engine, reinforced chassis, and a concealed drone rack in the cargo area.
A sleek, high-performance racing motorcycle. Axle's personal ride and his pride and joy. Custom painted in matte black with orange accents.
A high-end commlink popular with professionals. Reliable, fast, and difficult to hack.
A professional-grade toolkit for vehicle repair and modification. Includes diagnostic equipment, wrenches, welding gear, and specialized automotive tools.
system.gameEffect: Required for Automotive Mechanic tests. Provides a workshop bonus.

system.description: A specialized device for riggers that allows simultaneous control and monitoring of multiple drones and vehicles. Mounted in the GMC Bulldog's cab.
system.gameEffect: Can share autosofts among all slaved drones. Noise reduction equal to rating. Can slave (rating x 3) devices.

system.description: A multi-spectrum sensor package including cameras, microphones, motion detectors, and atmospheric sensors. Installed in the GMC Bulldog.
A basic field medical kit kept in the Bulldog. Good enough for patching up the worst of the bleeding.
system.gameEffect: Provides dice for First Aid tests. Rating determines dice pool.

system.description: The character has an intuitive understanding of vehicles and how they work. Things just feel right when they're behind the wheel.
system.gameEffect: +1 dice pool modifier to all Vehicle skill tests.

system.description: The character is obsessed with machines, vehicles, and drones. They can spend hours tinkering and modifying their gear.
system.gameEffect: +2 dice pool modifier to vehicle modification tests.

system.description: Electronics have a tendency to glitch around the character. Commlinks reset, devices malfunction, and maglocks jam at the worst possible moments.
system.gameEffect: When using electronic devices (not vehicles or drones), roll 1 die. On a 1, the device glitches.

system.description: Diego has a deep distrust and antipathy toward corporate security forces, stemming from his wrongful termination by Ares. He can barely contain his contempt when dealing with corp sec.
system.gameEffect: Social tests against corporate security personnel receive a negative modifier.

system.description: An ork mechanic who runs a no-questions-asked garage in Auburn. Old friend from Diego's street racing days. Reliable source for hard-to-find vehicle parts and off-the-books repairs.
A human woman who operates as a fixer in the underground street racing scene. She arranges races, places bets, and can connect runners with wheelman jobs. Knows everyone on the circuit.
A CAS military officer stationed at a base near Dallas. Old acquaintance from Diego's youth. Can occasionally provide military-grade intel or surplus equipment through back channels.
An elven fixer with a wide network of contacts throughout the Seattle sprawl. Professional and businesslike, Neon arranges jobs and takes a fair cut. Recently acquired as a contact.

A converted auto shop in Auburn that serves as both Diego's home and workspace. The living area is a loft above the garage floor, cramped but functional. The real value is the workshop space below, where he can work on vehicles and drones without attracting attention.
